channel.title: Paksh: Health
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: DR Congo Faces Health Worker Shortage Amid Ebola Surge
item.description: The Democratic Republic of Congo is experiencing a growing shortage of health workers as Ebola cases surge by 73%, according to the World Health Organization (WHO). The outbreak is described as 'out-of-control' by Sky News. The situation… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: PM Modi highlights record Ayushman Bharat medical savings
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated that record savings have been achieved on medical expenses under the Ayushman Bharat scheme. The scheme aims to provide health insurance coverage to vulnerable Indians. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Cancer Care Models to be Discussed at 2026 World Cancer Congress
item.description: The National Comprehensive Cancer Network (NCCN) will present models for tailoring cancer care to different regions at the 2026 World Cancer Congress. The focus will be on regional customization of cancer treatment strategies. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Health Canada suspends licence of Winnipeg Grifols centre
item.description: Health Canada suspended the licence of a Grifols blood‑collection centre in Winnipeg and halted its collection activities, according to reports. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Tragedy strikes RIMS hospital in Adilabad
item.description: A tragedy occurred at the Regional Institute of Medical Sciences (RIMS) hospital in Adilabad, where smoke caused distress. Reports said poor management of the electrical system and air‑conditioners was blamed for the incident. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court flags ten‑fold price gap in essential cancer drug
item.description: The Supreme Court expressed shock at a ten‑fold price difference for an essential cancer medicine, noting that a drug priced at Rs 2,700 was being sold for Rs 27,000 and describing the overpricing as a daylight robbery. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: CDSCO Flags 220 Drugs for Kidney Disease Risk
item.description: India's Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO) has identified 220 drugs, including common painkillers and antibiotics, that are linked to a risk of kidney disease. The agency flagged these medications due to potential adverse… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Fire at Telangana Hospital's Newborn Unit Leaves Infants Dead, Children Rescued
item.description: A fire broke out in the neonatal care unit of the Regional Institute of Medical Sciences (RIMS) Hospital in Adilabad, Telangana. Some outlets reported two infants died, while another reported three infants died. The incident also led to… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 7 · Right 5.

item.title: Ayushman Bharat reaches 60 crore beneficiaries with ₹5 lakh cover
item.description: Ayushman Bharat provides ₹5 lakh annual health cover to more than 60 crore beneficiaries. Prime Minister Narendra Modi said on X that this makes it the largest healthcare scheme in the world. The BJP said it is globally number one in… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Karnataka launches plan to cut salt intake by 30% by 2030
item.description: Karnataka has launched an action plan aimed at reducing salt consumption by 30% by the year 2030. The plan targets salt intake at three levels: within households, in food consumed outside the home, and in processed and packaged foods. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Dog owners urged to protect pets from parvovirus in P.E.I.
item.description: An expert has advised dog owners in Prince Edward Island (P.E.I.) to take precautions to safeguard their pets following the detection of parvovirus. Separately, fatal dog attacks in Hong Kong have raised safety concerns, prompting advice… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Indigenous Leaders Seek Health Care Changes After Childbirth Death
item.description: Indigenous leaders in Saskatchewan are calling for changes to health care following the death of a woman during childbirth. The incident has also prompted discussions and potential legislative changes regarding families' control over a… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Researchers Develop Blood Test for Early Pancreatic Cancer Detection
item.description: Researchers have developed a blood test capable of detecting pancreatic cancer at an earlier stage. Separately, UK doctors have created a non-invasive test using urine and vaginal fluid samples to help rule out womb cancer in women… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Drug regulator warns on overuse of painkillers and antibiotics
item.description: India's drug regulator has issued an advisory warning about the health risks associated with the indiscriminate and repeated use of painkillers and antibiotics without medical advice. The regulator highlighted that such usage can lead to… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: India Approves First Dengue Vaccine, Qdenga
item.description: India has approved Qdenga, its first-ever vaccine for dengue fever. The Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO), under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, granted marketing authorisation for the vaccine. Dengue infects… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.
